periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the sagittal plane, converging toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid teardrop geometry with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with a significant vertical offset between the centroid and the narrow inferior point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep U-shaped curvature on the posterior margin relative to the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal-to-lumbar longitudinal span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial crown, with a gap roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular profile with high contour regularity.
